name: Killarney Park Hotel
positioning: Town-centre hotel in Killarney (officially The Killarney Park), a two-minute walk from Killarney National Park, with a signature restaurant, a whiskey room, a spa and services for golfers
best_for: Travelers who want a town-centre base a short walk from Killarney National Park
Golfers touring the courses of Kerry

facts.text: The hotel is in Killarney's town centre.
The Garden Suites have private wraparound balconies.
Connecting rooms are available for groups travelling together.
The Peregrine is the hotel's signature restaurant, offering relaxed contemporary fine dining.
The Peregrine is named after the National Park's most important protected bird species, the peregrine falcon.
Executive Head Chef Noel Enright and his team develop original dishes based on produce from local suppliers.
Afternoon Tea is served in The Peregrine on the first Sunday of each month.
The Garden Bar has the warmth and comfort of a traditional Irish pub.
Hydrotherapy facilities include a sauna, steam room, bubble pool and outside hot tub.
Personal trainers offer bespoke running experiences through Killarney National Park.
For golfers the hotel offers early breakfasts, packed lunches, secure golf club storage and a drying room for clubs, shoes and clothing.

highlights.text: Each suite has bespoke panoramic wallpapers created from historic watercolour paintings of Killarney National Park as it appeared two hundred years ago.
A two-minute walk from the hotel gate leads to the ancient oak forests of Killarney National Park.
The Whiskey Room, within The Garden Bar, showcases a collection of whiskeys from Ireland and beyond.
The Spa's relaxation area has a panoramic saltwater aquarium.
The Peregrine was designed by Kim Partridge Interiors.

considerations.text: The Spa is closed on Tuesdays.
Guests must be 18 or older to receive spa treatments.
The concierge cannot book tee times; guests contact each golf club directly.
